item.figure_description:
A vertical subtraction problem is displayed:
  942
− 5[blot]7
______
  415
The top number is 942. The bottom number being subtracted starts with the digit 5 in the hundreds place, has a dark liquid stain or blot covering the tens digit, and ends with the digit 7 in the units place. A horizontal line separates the subtraction from the result, 415.
